mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 66 degrees with clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park.

In city news, please be aware that a section of Highway M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 5 through October 7 for final pavement work. Additionally, utility and shoulder work remains ongoing in the area as part of the phase two construction project.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by more events later in the week including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and live music at various venues.

In our weekly police report, on September 14, a 37-year-old Verona man was taken into custody during a traffic stop for violating probation terms and failing to install a court-ordered ignition interlock device.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently open and will remain so until 10:00 PM tonight, so stop by and enjoy a treat.
